name: OpenWeatherMap
description: A weather provider: the weather at the device's location from OpenWeatherMap, for the Weather pages, the Weather Overlay and the Weather Visualizer. The API key and the kept answers they share (the units are the device's, in the System settings).

properties.name: apiKey
properties.title: API Key
properties.description: Your OpenWeatherMap key. The free plan is enough. A new key can take a couple of hours to start working. Test asks OpenWeatherMap whether it accepts the key.

properties.name: currentCacheHours
properties.title: Keep the Weather Now (hours)
properties.description: How long what OpenWeatherMap answered for the weather now is kept and shared by every page, overlay and task, so the free plan's calls are for new answers only. It changes quickly, so it is kept a short time. 0: ask every time.

properties.name: forecastCacheHours
properties.title: Keep the Forecast (hours)
properties.description: How long what OpenWeatherMap answered for the forecast (the next hours and days) is kept and shared by every page, overlay and task. 0: ask every time.

properties.name: staleDays
properties.title: Forget Unused Answers After (days)
properties.description: A kept answer nobody has used for this many days (a place you moved away from) is removed. 0: never.
